content.json:
# Vole Papillon d'Amour — performance et santé
Toutes les requêtes portent sur l'espace Log Analytics commun. Pour une requête lente, copier son `OperationId` et suivre la procédure « Diagnostiquer une latence API » de `11-observabilite.md`.

content.query:
AppRequests
| where AppRoleName == "vpd-api"
| summarize Requetes = count(), Echecs = countif(Success == false) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Débit et échecs

content.query:
AppRequests
| where AppRoleName == "vpd-api"
| summarize P50 = percentile(DurationMs, 50), P95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95), P99 = percentile(DurationMs, 99) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Latence (ms) — P50 / P95 / P99

content.query:
AppRequests
| where AppRoleName == "vpd-api"
| summarize Requetes = count(), Echecs = countif(Success == false), P50 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 50)), P95 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)), P99 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 99)), Max = round(max(DurationMs)) by Name
| extend TauxEchec = round(100.0 * Echecs / Requetes, 1)
| order by P95 desc
content.title: Opérations, triées par P95

content.query:
AppRequests
| where AppRoleName == "vpd-api"
| top 50 by DurationMs desc
| project TimeGenerated, Name, DurationMs = round(DurationMs), ResultCode, OperationId
content.title: Les 50 requêtes les plus lentes

content.query:
AppRequests
| where AppRoleName == "vpd-api"
| summarize Requetes = count() by ResultCode, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Codes de réponse

content.json: Temps passé dans chaque type de dépendance par opération. Une opération dont le temps SQL ou HTTP est proche de sa durée totale attend sa dépendance ; sinon le temps est dans le code API.

content.query:
let requests = AppRequests | where AppRoleName == "vpd-api"
    | project OperationId, Operation = Name, RequestMs = DurationMs;
AppDependencies
| where AppRoleName == "vpd-api"
| summarize DependencyMs = sum(DurationMs), Calls = count() by OperationId, DependencyType
| join kind=inner requests on OperationId
| summarize Requetes = dcount(OperationId), DureeMoyenneMs = round(avg(RequestMs)), DependanceMoyenneMs = round(avg(DependencyMs)), AppelsMoyens = round(avg(Calls), 1) by Operation, DependencyType
| extend PartDependance = round(100.0 * DependanceMoyenneMs / DureeMoyenneMs, 1)
| order by DependanceMoyenneMs desc
content.title: Décomposition moyenne par opération

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where AppRoleName == "vpd-api" and DependencyType =~ "SQL"
| summarize SqlCalls = count() by OperationId
| join kind=inner (AppRequests | where AppRoleName == "vpd-api" | project OperationId, Name) on OperationId
| summarize AppelsSqlMoyens = round(avg(SqlCalls), 1), AppelsSqlMax = max(SqlCalls), Requetes = count() by Name
| order by AppelsSqlMax desc
| take 20
content.title: Requêtes SQL par opération (détection N+1)

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where DependencyType =~ "SQL"
| summarize Appels = count(), P95 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)), Max = round(max(DurationMs)) by AppRoleName, Instruction = substring(Data, 0, 300)
| order by P95 desc
| take 30
content.title: Instructions SQL les plus lentes

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where AppRoleName in ("vpd-api", "vpd-worker", "vpd-catalog")
| summarize Appels = count(), Echecs = countif(Success == false), P50 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 50)), P95 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)) by AppRoleName, DependencyType, Target
| order by P95 desc
content.title: Dépendances par cible

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where Name == "books.metadata.provider"
| extend Fournisseur = tostring(Properties["book.metadata.provider"]), Issue = tostring(Properties["book.metadata.outcome"])
| summarize Appels = count(), P50 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 50)), P95 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)) by AppRoleName, Fournisseur, Issue
| order by Appels desc
content.title: Fournisseurs bibliographiques

content.query:
AppExceptions
| where ClientType != "Browser"
| summarize Exceptions = count() by AppRoleName, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Exceptions serveur par service

content.query:
AppRequests
| where Success == false
| summarize Echecs = count(), Dernier = max(TimeGenerated) by AppRoleName, Name, ResultCode
| order by Echecs desc
content.title: Requêtes en échec

content.query:
AppExceptions
| summarize Occurrences = count(), Derniere = max(TimeGenerated), Exemple = take_any(OuterMessage), OperationId = take_any(OperationId) by AppRoleName, ClientType, ProblemId
| order by Occurrences desc
content.title: Exceptions regroupées

content.query:
AppTraces
| where SeverityLevel >= 2
| summarize Occurrences = count(), Dernier = max(TimeGenerated), Exemple = take_any(Message) by AppRoleName, SeverityLevel, Modele = tostring(Properties["{OriginalFormat}"])
| order by Occurrences desc
| take 50
content.title: Journaux Warning et Error

content.query:
AppRequests
| where AppRoleName has "worker"
| summarize Executions = count(), Echecs = countif(Success == false), P50 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 50)), P95 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)), Derniere = max(TimeGenerated) by Name
| order by Name asc
content.title: Exécutions des fonctions

content.query:
AppTraces
| where Message startswith "Worker sweep completed"
| summarize Balayages = count(), AlertesEnvoyees = sum(toint(Properties.AlertSent)), AlertesEnEchec = sum(toint(Properties.AlertFailed)), AnnoncesBasculees = sum(toint(Properties.ReleasedAnnouncements)) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Balayages et alertes e-mail

content.query:
AppRequests
| where AppRoleName has "worker"
| summarize P95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by Name, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Durée des exécutions (ms)

content.query:
AppAvailabilityResults
| summarize Disponibilite = round(100.0 * countif(Success == true) / count(), 2) by Name, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Disponibilité (%)

content.query:
AppRequests
| where AppRoleName == "vpd-catalog"
| summarize Requetes = count(), P95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95), Echecs = countif(Success == false) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Rendu SSR du catalogue

content.query:
AppPageViews
| extend App = tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/")[-1])
| summarize Vues = count(), P50 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 50)), P95 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)) by App, Name
| order by Vues desc
| take 50
content.title: Chargement des pages navigateur

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where ClientType == "Browser"
| extend App = tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/")[-1])
| summarize Appels = count(), Echecs = countif(Success == false), P95 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)) by App, Name
| order by P95 desc
| take 30
content.title: Appels API vus du navigateur

content.query:
AppExceptions
| where ClientType == "Browser"
| extend App = tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/")[-1])
| summarize Occurrences = count(), Exemple = take_any(OuterMessage), Derniere = max(TimeGenerated) by App, ProblemId
| order by Occurrences desc
content.title: Erreurs navigateur
